description.zh: 密度 ρ = m/V：同种均匀材料的质量与体积成正比，比值只由材料决定；比较密度可判断浮沉，排水法可测不规则物体的体积。仅适用于实心均匀物体和常温常压典型值。
description.en: Density ρ = m/V: for one uniform material, mass is proportional to volume and the ratio depends only on the material; comparing densities predicts float or sink, and displacement measures odd-shaped volumes. Valid for solid uniform objects at typical room conditions.

reason.zh: 在质量—体积图上，同种材料的点落在过原点的直线上，这条直线的斜率 m/V 就是密度。
reason.en: On a mass–volume graph, points of one material fall on a line through the origin, and the slope m/V of that line is the density.

title.zh: 为什么有的东西浮、有的东西沉？
title.en: Why do some things float and others sink?

ask.zh: 同种均匀材料，质量和体积成正比——画成质量-体积图，是一条直线吗？斜率是什么？
ask.en: For one uniform material, mass is proportional to volume — plotted as mass against volume, is it a straight line, and what is its slope?

ask.zh: 两块材料，图上斜率大的密度大还是小？密度大的放进水里会怎样？
ask.en: Of two materials, does the steeper line mean higher or lower density? What happens in water to the denser one?

reveal.zh: 质量÷体积 = 密度，图上斜率就是密度；密度比水大的下沉，比水小的上浮。
reveal.en: Mass ÷ volume is density, which is exactly the slope of that line; denser than water sinks, less dense floats.
